title: Relief mission reports generator delivery
text: The International Relief Mission confirmed it delivered 20 generators to Northport hospital on Tuesday after a regional power outage.

title: Power plant remains offline
text: Regional officials denied that the coastal power plant restarted full operations on Friday. The plant remains offline for safety checks.

title: Rail crossing opens for aid freight
text: Transport monitors reported that the border rail crossing reopened for humanitarian freight after a two-day inspection pause.

title: School repair grant announced
text: The municipal council announced a school repair grant for five damaged classrooms in Eastford district.

title: Satellite hub discussion postponed
text: Local authorities said the satellite internet hub proposal was postponed and no opening date has been confirmed.

title: Radio procurement talks continue
text: Procurement officials discussed emergency radio units for three clinics, but no purchase contract has been signed.

title: Observers report Eastford shelling
text: Independent observers documented shelling near Eastford on Monday and published photos of damaged power lines.

title: Ceasefire corridor delayed overnight
text: Aid groups said the ceasefire corridor had not opened after midnight despite earlier planning documents.
